name: Chunk-Based Voxel Rendering
definition: A method to render voxels by dividing the world into fixed-size chunks, each with its own vertex buffer that is updated when blocks change.
summary: Chunk-Based Voxel Rendering optimizes performance by subdividing worlds into fixed-size chunks that generate single meshes per unit, differing from other methods by explicitly constructing geometric primitives rather than relying on scalar field thresholding or procedural generation.
